name: External Identity Provider Unlink Success
summary: An authenticated user explicitly removes an existing external provider association from the current durable identity without deleting or switching the durable user.
finalOutcome: The selected external provider association is removed from the current durable identity, and the same user remains authenticated.

sourceReferences.note: RemoveExternalLoginAsync requires the target user id to match the acting user and records OAuthRemoveUserLogin before removing the association.

External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
